caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a mahogany table on an off-white, lightly speckled background. It is composed of three main views: a top view, a front elevation, and a side elevation. The top view (upper left) displays a scalloped, semi-circular tabletop measured at 32 inches in width and 17.5 inches in depth, with additional dashed lines indicating a fold-out or extension. The front elevation (center left) shows the table’s curved lower apron and four slender, tapered legs, nicely detailing the curve of the apron and the dimensions of the height at 32.5 inches overall. The side elevation (right) illustrates the thickness of the top, the decorative rectangular panel on the side apron, and the curve of the folded extension with dashed lines, quantifying leg height and the overall height at 32.5 inches. The drawing uses thin, precise black lines on the beige background, with various measurement indications and small text labels specifying details and dimensions. In the top right corner, the title "MAHOGANY TABLE," a reference number, and the name "Nicholas Acampora" are written in uppercase letters.
title: Table
